stories.title: Brazil votes as Lula faces Flavio Bolsonaro in runoff
stories.summary: Brazilians are voting in a presidential runoff pitting incumbent Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva against Flavio Bolsonaro, son of the imprisoned former president. The result will shape the region for years and test how Brazil handles a deeply polarized race.

stories.title: More than 1,300 arrested as protests sweep France
stories.summary: French police detained more than 1,300 people as clashes followed another day of mass demonstrations, with hundreds of thousands marching nationwide. Protests also spread to other European cities, adding pressure on the government.

stories.title: Israel to close West Bank crossings on election day
stories.summary: The Israeli military announced restrictions on the movement of Palestinian workers and closures at West Bank crossings around Tuesday election. The measures deepen friction over access and travel during the vote.

stories.title: Obama hits the trail for Democrats ahead of midterms
stories.summary: Barack Obama used his first midterm rallies to attack the Trump administration, saying the election is the last best chance to at least rein in some of the foolishness of this administration. Both parties are fighting for control of Congress.

stories.title: UK datacenter builders face a three-department maze
stories.summary: Building a large UK datacenter means dealing separately with Whitehall departments covering construction, telecoms and energy, and a minister insists responsibilities are clear. Operators say the split slows approvals as AI demand strains grid and planning capacity.

stories.title: Musk says SpaceX restricted Ukraine Starlink service
stories.summary: Elon Musk said SpaceX limited Starlink in Ukraine after accusing Kyiv of violating terms of service by using the network for military activity, and service has since been restored. The admission renews questions about who controls battlefield connectivity.

stories.title: Cerebras details serving trillion-parameter models
stories.summary: Cerebras published how it deploys trillion-parameter frontier models on wafer-scale hardware, covering memory layout and partitioning choices. It offers a rare engineering look at inference as labs push ever larger models into production.

stories.title: Browns draft plans could reshape the Shedeur Sanders era
stories.summary: With Cleveland still unsettled at quarterback in Week 7, analysis suggests the 2027 draft could dramatically change the room around Shedeur Sanders. It frames a decision point for a front office that has cycled through passers.

stories.title: Browns extend DT Maliek Collins for two years, 30 million dollars
stories.summary: Cleveland agreed to a two-year, 30 million dollar extension with defensive tackle Maliek Collins that includes 23 million in guarantees, his agent said. The deal keeps a productive interior rusher through 2028 and rewards his form since 2025.

stories.title: ESPN projects Ohio State among top CFP seeds after Week 8
stories.summary: ESPN updated its College Football Playoff top-12 projection after a Week 8 slate that produced upsets across the top 25. Ohio State, idle on a bye, holds a high seed ahead of the committee first rankings.

stories.title: Ohio State club football puts up 105 points in rout
stories.summary: Ohio State club football scored 105 points against Wright State, including 98 in the first half. The lopsided result offered weekend football relief while the varsity team sits on a bye.

stories.title: Verstappen proposes drastic fix for COTA bumps
stories.summary: After drivers raised concerns in the Friday briefing, Max Verstappen proposed major measures to deal with the extreme bumps at the Circuit of the Americas, which sits on high-plasticity Texas clay. He also brushed off a jibe from the track boss.

stories.title: Antonelli says pole shows Mercedes upgrade payoff
stories.summary: Championship leader Kimi Antonelli took his seventh pole of 2026 at the United States Grand Prix, beating Max Verstappen, and said the result shows Mercedes is finally seeing returns on its troubled Malaysia upgrade package.

stories.title: Leclerc and Hamilton split on Ferrari qualifying slump
stories.summary: Ferrari looked like the team to beat in practice but ended qualifying fourth and fifth in Austin, and Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton offered different explanations. The race will show whether setup or tyre preparation was the problem.

stories.title: Norris laments a very bad job in Austin qualifying
stories.summary: Lando Norris qualified eighth for the United States Grand Prix after a lap was deleted for track limits, and said he did a very bad job despite believing a front row was possible. He starts alongside McLaren teammate Oscar Piastri on row four.

stories.title: Man sentenced in Columbus shooting that hospitalized woman
stories.summary: A man pleaded guilty and was sentenced for a Columbus shooting that sent a woman to the hospital. The plea closes one case from a violent-crime caseload that has drawn attention across the city.

stories.title: Central Ohio nonprofit opens mobile boutique for trafficking survivors
stories.summary: A Central Ohio nonprofit created a mobile boutique that brings clothing and supplies directly to survivors of human trafficking. Organizers say the bus removes transportation barriers that keep survivors from reaching services.

stories.title: Denison to close student-built Homestead housing co-op
stories.summary: Denison University will close its Homestead housing cooperative, which features student-built cabins, ending a long-running experiment in student-run living in Licking County. Current residents are being told to find other housing.

stories.title: Haitians march from Springfield to Columbus in solidarity
stories.summary: Haitians and supporters marched from Springfield to Columbus as federal protections for Haitian migrants remain contested. The route put the debate on display in two Ohio cities at the center of the national argument.
